event.title: Vozinha Signs with Colo-Colo After World Cup Success
event.canonical_title: Vozinha Signs with Colo-Colo After World Cup Success
event.summary: Cape Verde goalkeeper Vozinha has officially joined Chilean club Colo-Colo after a successful World Cup campaign. He expressed that this transfer represents the best moment of his club career, following his impressive performances at the tournament. Vozinha previously played for Portuguese side Chaves before making the move to Colo-Colo.
